requirements.text: The system shall ensure compliance with the Apollo Pilot Safety Report and EM Motion Planner specifications at all operational times.
The system shall implement a multi-layer safety architecture including passive, active, and functional safety mechanisms to ensure collision protection and fail-safe operations.
The system shall execute a Minimal Risk Maneuver within 5 seconds upon detecting critical failures while allowing jerk limits to be relaxed under defined scenarios.
The system shall continuously monitor Operational Design Domain compliance and issue timely HMI warnings for human takeover.
The system shall maintain a jerk value below 0.5 m/s³ during normal operation but allow for relaxation during emergencies.
The system shall implement end-to-end data encryption while optimizing processing time to maintain responsiveness.
The system shall establish emergency protocols that minimize energy usage during critical failures.
